tracks.strongest_negative_control: instrumented and hook-free runs must agree

evidence.outcome: NO indicator survives: on a split whose calibration arms are disjoint from its evaluation arms, no 160-step indicator separates healthy from failed arms without a false positive

tracks.cost: 6 arms, protocol pre-registered before any indicator was computed

tracks.hypothesis: projecting the deep update onto L1 margin half-spaces preserves winner identities where clipping and full-vector PCGrad do not
tracks.strongest_negative_control: recompute the TRUE margins after the real AdamW step; a linearisation that looks satisfied but still crosses must be counted
tracks.cost: one extra autograd per guarded item
tracks.verdict: the pilot measured the thing it was built for. Deep-attributable L1 identity changes are +7/-2 (r4_08), +5/+1 (r6_02), +4/-2 (r6_03), -1/0 (r6_04) at steps 96/160, against a measured run-to-run floor of +/-5 to +/-6 on the same arm and step. The effect is inside the noise and changes sign. Protecting L1 boundaries would be protecting something that is not breaking.

evidence.why: /home/wlia0047/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/stage2_RQ-VAE/r7_f_separation does not exist: the track produced no report, so it has no evidence to contribute

tracks.strongest_negative_control: a uniform posterior scores well on the loss while collapsing hard diversity; entropy, effective codes and margins are monitored separately
tracks.cost: one softmax over the L1 codebook per step
tracks.blocker: no measurement: the prototype has its math, its independent VJP oracle and its gaming diagnostics, but no pilot was run, so there is nothing to evaluate
tracks.r7_01_candidate: NOT EVALUATED: the hypothesis class is the only one consistent with tracks B, C and E, but it has no evidence of its own

noise_floor.why_it_matters: issue #79 compared an audited trajectory against an independent probe as if two runs of the same code were identical. They are not. A cross-run difference must be read against this floor before it is called a mechanism effect.

r7_01_selection.rule: at most one full 3000-epoch candidate, and only if its own track resolved it AND track A established control parity; otherwise the honest outcome is that no candidate survived
r7_01_selection.outcome: NO CANDIDATE SURVIVED, and that is the finding rather than a shortfall. Control parity is established, so the hypotheses could be tested rather than merely asserted. Track E, the only candidate with a measurement, was rejected on it: deep-attributable L1 boundary crossings are inside the run-to-run noise floor and change sign, so protecting boundaries protects something that is not breaking. Track F's hypothesis class is the only one consistent with all three measured tracks -- tracks B, C and E independently point at occupancy and distribution rather than gradient direction or boundary fragility -- but F has no pilot of its own, so it cannot be promoted on the strength of other tracks' agreement. Promoting it would repeat exactly the error this programme was opened to correct.
